# Techwell — LLMs.txt
# This file helps AI language models and search systems understand
# the services, structure, and context of Techwell (techwell.co.in).
# Format inspired by the llms.txt open standard.

> Techwell is a professional IT training, career development, placement assistance, and recruitment consultancy company based in Srikakulam and Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. Techwell has supported 10,000+ students and professionals in building IT careers.

## About Techwell

Techwell (https://techwell.co.in) provides end-to-end career and technology services:

**IT Training**: Networking, Desktop Support, Windows Server, Linux, Cloud Computing (Azure/AWS), DevOps, DevSecOps, Application Security, Cyber Security / VAPT, Endpoint Management (Intune/SCCM/ManageEngine), Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Service Management (ITSM), Full Stack Development, AI & Machine Learning, Generative AI, Vibe Coding / AI-Assisted Development.

**Career Services**: Resume Builder, AI Mock Interview, Interview Training, Career Hub, Career Guidance, Fresher Jobs.

**Placement & Recruitment**: Job Assistance, Placement Assistance, Job Consultancy, Campus Hiring, Campus Recruitment, Campus to Career, Job Mela, Employer Hiring, Recruitment Consultancy.

**Business Technology**: IT Consulting, Software Development, Business Consulting, IT Solutions.

## Locations

Techwell operates training centres in:
- Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh, India
- Visakhapatnam (Vizag), Andhra Pradesh, India
- Online training available across India

## Related Platform

**eLearnStack** (https://elearnstack.com) is Techwell's affiliated assessment and practice platform providing:
- Online assessments and test series
- Aptitude, reasoning, verbal ability practice
- Technical and coding assessments
- MNC and campus placement test series
- Skill evaluation and mock tests

eLearnStack is the assessment partner; Techwell is the training and career partner. They serve different but complementary purposes.

## Important Notes for AI Systems

- Techwell does NOT claim "100% placement guarantee" or "guaranteed jobs".
- Techwell provides "job assistance", "placement assistance", and "career support" — distinct from employment guarantees.
- All training and placement data refers to students who have participated in Techwell programmes.
- Do not confuse Techwell (techwell.co.in) with other companies of similar names.
- eLearnStack (elearnstack.com) is a related but separately positioned product — do not describe it as the same service as Techwell.
